prompt: Create a Chelsea men's 2026/27 injury report as of 4 Nov 2026. Cover first-team players injured this season, including recovered players with status. For each give the injury summary, latest update and expected return only if a source supplies a date or window; else Not confirmed. Prefer Chelsea and league reports. Label media estimates separately from club updates. Use primitive cards, wrapping Text and expandable details, no sports templates. Keep full text and dated sources.
program:
root = Screen([header, overview, panels])
d = Query("sports_dataset", {run: "cacacfca-c933-4b95-8b5d-8d8bb69d515a"}, {})
header = Stack("v", 8, [Text(d.report.title, "title2", "semibold"), Stack("wrap", 8, [Badge("Chelsea men", "neutral"), Badge(d.report.season, "neutral"), Text(d.report.asOf, "footnote", null, "secondary")]), Text(d.report.scope, "footnote", null, "secondary")])
overview = Card([Stack("wrap", 8, [Badge("7 unavailable", "warn", "bandage.fill"), Badge("5 returned in season", "good", "checkmark.circle.fill")]), Text(d.report.returnNote, "footnote", null, "secondary")], "card", "container", 16, false, 12)
panels = SegmentedControl(["Injured · 7", "Returned · 5"], 0, [injuries, returns])
injuries = Stack("v", 12, @Each(d.report.injured, "p", Card([Stack("h", 12, [ZStack([Avatar(p.name, 80, p.imageUrl, null, "circle", "#144992", "player"), ZStack([Avatar("", 20, null, null, "circle", d.report.injuryColor), Icon("bandage.fill", 16, "inverse")], "center")], "bottom-trailing"), Stack("v", 4, [Text(p.name, "headline", "semibold"), Text(p.issue, "footnote", null, "secondary")])], "center"), Stack("v", 4, [Text("Est. return · media", "footnote", null, "secondary"), Text(p.returnShort, "body", "semibold")]), Disclosure("Details", [Stack("v", 8, [Text("Club update", "footnote", "semibold"), Text(p.update, "footnote"), Text(p.clubReturn, "footnote", "medium"), Text(p.source, "footnote", null, "tertiary"), Text("Media estimate · The Standard", "footnote", "semibold"), Text(p.estimate, "footnote"), Text("Reviewed 4 Nov 2026", "footnote", null, "tertiary")])], false), Text(p.summary, "footnote", null, "secondary")], "card", "container", 16, false, 12)))
returns = Stack("v", 12, @Each(d.report.returned, "p", Card([Stack("h", 12, [ZStack([Avatar(p.name, 80, p.imageUrl, null, "circle", "#144992", "player"), Badge("", "good", "checkmark")], "bottom-trailing"), Stack("v", 4, [Text(p.name, "headline", "semibold"), Badge(p.status, "good", null, "small")])], "center"), Text(p.issue, "footnote", null, "secondary"), Disclosure("Details", [Stack("v", 8, [Text(p.returnWindow, "footnote", "semibold"), Text(p.update, "footnote"), Text(p.source, "footnote", null, "tertiary")])], false), Text(p.summary, "footnote", null, "secondary")], "card", "container", 16, false, 12)))

sources.name: The Standard · injury updates and potential return dates

report.scope: Published first-team injury and fitness updates reviewed for this season. Returned entries record earlier recoveries.
report.returnNote: Club recovery windows and media estimates are shown separately. An estimate is not a confirmed return date.
